name: Brutalist Imperitor
body:
School transmutation [lawful]; Level cleric/oracle 5, paladin 3, sorcerer/wizard 5

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser brutalist imperitor, except you gain low-light vision, a +5 resistance bonus against poison, death, disease, and sleep effects, and DR 5/chaos, and you gain regeneration 5/chaotic. In addition, your natural weapons and any weapons you wield are considered lawfully-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
